mode.title: Mode
mode.description: depth = resting liquidity within 0.5, 1 and 2 per cent of mid on each venue. slippage = what a market order of a given size would actually pay. compare = which venue fills that size cheapest.

symbols.title: Coins
symbols.description: BTC, ETH, SOL, or a full pair such as BTC-USDT. Coins are matched against the quote asset below.

venues.title: Exchanges
venues.description: okx, gate, bitget, kucoin. Empty returns all four. Binance and Bybit block datacentre addresses and cannot be covered.

quoteAsset.title: Quote asset
quoteAsset.description: The asset the coin is priced in. USDT is listed on all four venues; other quotes exist on some venues only.

orderSizesUsd.title: Order sizes
orderSizesUsd.description: Slippage and compare modes. Order sizes in quote currency, for example 10000, 100000, 1000000.

side.title: Side
side.description: Slippage and compare modes. Buy walks the ask side, sell walks the bid side.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
